Hangover fatigue is ` [Highlight start] next-day exhaustion and sluggishness caused by alcohol's disruption of your sleep, hydration, blood sugar, and inflammatory response [Highlight end] ` . Symptoms typically start 6 to 8 hours after drinking—as blood alcohol drops—and usually ease within 8 to 24 hours as your body recovers.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShQEBxCJF1w0g2JdL94xKjckIZcTnBy2tg-bdFT0UAPkn713D0ekRis9eOPLmafRvQa-9PLVgwvAKEa8PWzWk6Kc2FFMoq9Yl2kYvh5EVDksxbWM8Pd3ZDu54mBFPu7UxEI3YqOglBaOUg9LTs-MJV26OZlh6pydp5c4SFLkir6fvYIISydaM)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZgHEIkXXZx5oX0zmGftVQph5YB5_MV6R_Xz7i7A7fyTUrFPFT_mqrDT7aGX8CjsU1IRGAeoa75BopYx5RoY7bG2vQ4w2ChbCybl7YTumeKL5WrLKY3KnKPk4U7C7HvPy6U-l3uaokg)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZQHEIkXXrLs_ty9jTJRRf9T6UzIyzM6oDWUOwcSVCc1jHydA8K8igJNnMXTqWpMJhAizO-bpni23HYX1omaJxW_-s8A400D0jH08nBLs9rDfTcavLu065LVgWjjigqqErf7ygpKe)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESeAHEIkXXj7pfRZ4YTAbKL4n7d1BtHCdax0tieAxsQHYlo-KAwDw4lb2cy5irZ5b7I4sEXZK5nAbDo7YsVjLsXw48HOOCKXqNgBqhXz2Y04DekyLm2x0DBPrdavLvq65R1ILMMlRbwbXLP6qutlc1lkUflr_ccffBzQ)

### Why Hangover Fatigue Happens

- **Disrupted sleep:** Alcohol may help you fall asleep faster, but it fragments sleep later in the night and reduces restorative sleep.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShQEBxCJF1w0g2JdL94xKjckIZcTnBy2tg-bdFT0UAPkn713D0ekRis9eOPLmafRvQa-9PLVgwvAKEa8PWzWk6Kc2FFMoq9Yl2kYvh5EVDksxbWM8Pd3ZDu54mBFPu7UxEI3YqOglBaOUg9LTs-MJV26OZlh6pydp5c4SFLkir6fvYIISydaM)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZgHEIkXXZx5oX0zmGftVQph5YB5_MV6R_Xz7i7A7fyTUrFPFT_mqrDT7aGX8CjsU1IRGAeoa75BopYx5RoY7bG2vQ4w2ChbCybl7YTumeKL5WrLKY3KnKPk4U7C7HvPy6U-l3uaokg)
- **Mild dehydration:** Alcohol suppresses vasopressin (antidiuretic hormone), increasing urination and fluid loss.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShQEBxCJF1w0g2JdL94xKjckIZcTnBy2tg-bdFT0UAPkn713D0ekRis9eOPLmafRvQa-9PLVgwvAKEa8PWzWk6Kc2FFMoq9Yl2kYvh5EVDksxbWM8Pd3ZDu54mBFPu7UxEI3YqOglBaOUg9LTs-MJV26OZlh6pydp5c4SFLkir6fvYIISydaM)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZQHEIkXXrLs_ty9jTJRRf9T6UzIyzM6oDWUOwcSVCc1jHydA8K8igJNnMXTqWpMJhAizO-bpni23HYX1omaJxW_-s8A400D0jH08nBLs9rDfTcavLu065LVgWjjigqqErf7ygpKe)
- **Inflammation:** Alcohol metabolism triggers inflammatory chemicals (like cytokines) that cause whole-body sluggishness and malaise.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShQEBxCJF1w0g2JdL94xKjckIZcTnBy2tg-bdFT0UAPkn713D0ekRis9eOPLmafRvQa-9PLVgwvAKEa8PWzWk6Kc2FFMoq9Yl2kYvh5EVDksxbWM8Pd3ZDu54mBFPu7UxEI3YqOglBaOUg9LTs-MJV26OZlh6pydp5c4SFLkir6fvYIISydaM)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESawHEIkXX2EYF2zzAvMP5k5OXRMKtXXov7XBfYeBre0iIMDnY3xbzXeN9EAFlWH2AJN2ALAAWHK118gF2yOrn2kQg6RQXrmRfCJXI4LUuPr_LJkLUIBNFq3_lNir1ZFQLooUEiYIamkzhm5VG)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZQHEIkXXp_eid8X7aXDK5N3wYBXYcevRlEQnCA8LhZFLaV350xQCQKYkld-qHf3G6uQxzNg78Yeq5aQjLdlZixg9xHzfJSzeJsaLNd2NH_TLgchvqfQmLxJ4_iTT1H3-dCwrLDqR)
- **Blood sugar swings:** Alcohol interferes with glucose regulation, which can leave you feeling weak or drained.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZgHEIkXXZx5oX0zmGftVQph5YB5_MV6R_Xz7i7A7fyTUrFPFT_mqrDT7aGX8CjsU1IRGAeoa75BopYx5RoY7bG2vQ4w2ChbCybl7YTumeKL5WrLKY3KnKPk4U7C7HvPy6U-l3uaokg)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZQHEIkXXrLs_ty9jTJRRf9T6UzIyzM6oDWUOwcSVCc1jHydA8K8igJNnMXTqWpMJhAizO-bpni23HYX1omaJxW_-s8A400D0jH08nBLs9rDfTcavLu065LVgWjjigqqErf7ygpKe)

### How to Cope Safely

- **Give it time and rest:** Only time clears alcohol byproducts and restores normal brain and immune activity. Extra sleep helps offset poor sleep quality.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbAHEIkXXdrjmbYKZx4W4n57yAL0bNZwHzrhfACEOqyajBQqWfIhvI2SkmCE7JwvjotpncogLZ0IFr1Yj1ucEBeUHR63iawHhamO1tzP8b9I-ibqUVvufyLiX1Tu81QbozHOelKCr0UTjSdZKOQ)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShQEBxCJF1w0g2JdL94xKjckIZcTnBy2tg-bdFT0UAPkn713D0ekRis9eOPLmafRvQa-9PLVgwvAKEa8PWzWk6Kc2FFMoq9Yl2kYvh5EVDksxbWM8Pd3ZDu54mBFPu7UxEI3YqOglBaOUg9LTs-MJV26OZlh6pydp5c4SFLkir6fvYIISydaM)
- **Sip fluids and eat light carbs:** Drink water and eat gentle carbohydrates (like toast or crackers) to help steady your energy and stomach.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESeAHEIkXXj7pfRZ4YTAbKL4n7d1BtHCdax0tieAxsQHYlo-KAwDw4lb2cy5irZ5b7I4sEXZK5nAbDo7YsVjLsXw48HOOCKXqNgBqhXz2Y04DekyLm2x0DBPrdavLvq65R1ILMMlRbwbXLP6qutlc1lkUflr_ccffBzQ)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESkQEBxCJF184nua7oVpRXCq-AfR3D-XtMBQUgwrHE-jb6RgsMfmuTMgYaCDSuR5VQq4s3X_s37WmGfR9F2JpSSolepNhMGGsCgexc-aY6ugjJZVHPRksPHEKXJRwoPLJ0EV5kyu-XAvo3yTCWfY2tXrXYP1UhLYK5uZNBgnEcIfHTJNHZkCDkJxRaJYQWWiBTQ_Ut)
- **Be cautious with caffeine and pain relievers:** A modest cup of coffee is generally fine, though heavy caffeine can worsen jitteriness or a racing heart. Avoid acetaminophen (Tylenol) with alcohol due to liver toxicity risk, and use NSAIDs (like ibuprofen) carefully if your stomach is irritated.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESngEBxCJF19JGqLnp0xVbL4b1TxJhifbRbfqanAFq468oOKwCa04N89RMBkzOjtgeq9jhCUgeUWB3xtOFhtz2dyXHDx05SNsreuMiXOHGCMOHcP8DTlmkkYhkp-mpsKocgctqVb2zRS8XTbFBXM0ZjLebPe4prcnhKUuBnfNI4y5RUJ--jT3Snh02guvMrpot7zTyy4-5Wgj57kIAtDnySQ)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShQEBxCJF1w0g2JdL94xKjckIZcTnBy2tg-bdFT0UAPkn713D0ekRis9eOPLmafRvQa-9PLVgwvAKEa8PWzWk6Kc2FFMoq9Yl2kYvh5EVDksxbWM8Pd3ZDu54mBFPu7UxEI3YqOglBaOUg9LTs-MJV26OZlh6pydp5c4SFLkir6fvYIISydaM)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbAHEIkXXdrjmbYKZx4W4n57yAL0bNZwHzrhfACEOqyajBQqWfIhvI2SkmCE7JwvjotpncogLZ0IFr1Yj1ucEBeUHR63iawHhamO1tzP8b9I-ibqUVvufyLiX1Tu81QbozHOelKCr0UTjSdZKOQ)

For more details on mechanisms and recovery, see the [National Institute on Alcohol Abuse and Alcoholism](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShQEBxCJF1w0g2JdL94xKjckIZcTnBy2tg-bdFT0UAPkn713D0ekRis9eOPLmafRvQa-9PLVgwvAKEa8PWzWk6Kc2FFMoq9Yl2kYvh5EVDksxbWM8Pd3ZDu54mBFPu7UxEI3YqOglBaOUg9LTs-MJV26OZlh6pydp5c4SFLkir6fvYIISydaM) and the [Cleveland Clinic](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESeAHEIkXXj7pfRZ4YTAbKL4n7d1BtHCdax0tieAxsQHYlo-KAwDw4lb2cy5irZ5b7I4sEXZK5nAbDo7YsVjLsXw48HOOCKXqNgBqhXz2Y04DekyLm2x0DBPrdavLvq65R1ILMMlRbwbXLP6qutlc1lkUflr_ccffBzQ).[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShQEBxCJF1w0g2JdL94xKjckIZcTnBy2tg-bdFT0UAPkn713D0ekRis9eOPLmafRvQa-9PLVgwvAKEa8PWzWk6Kc2FFMoq9Yl2kYvh5EVDksxbWM8Pd3ZDu54mBFPu7UxEI3YqOglBaOUg9LTs-MJV26OZlh6pydp5c4SFLkir6fvYIISydaM)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESeAHEIkXXj7pfRZ4YTAbKL4n7d1BtHCdax0tieAxsQHYlo-KAwDw4lb2cy5irZ5b7I4sEXZK5nAbDo7YsVjLsXw48HOOCKXqNgBqhXz2Y04DekyLm2x0DBPrdavLvq65R1ILMMlRbwbXLP6qutlc1lkUflr_ccffBzQ)Are you asking for **yourself** or **someone else** , and are there **other symptoms** (like nausea, headache, or dizziness) or a **timeline** you want to share?
